= Shell scripting / shell execution

Libraries for scripting shell commands and executing child processes from
JavaScript.

* https://github.com/sindresorhus/nano-spawn[nano-spawn]
* https://github.com/shelljs/shelljs[shelljs]
* https://david.deno.dev/posts/dax-node-js/[dax]
* https://google.github.io/zx/[zx]
* https://github.com/sindresorhus/execa[Execa]
